data.label: Restaurant Confirms Order

data.label: Order Confirmed by Restaurant?

data.label: Driver Picks Up Order

data.label: Delivery Timer
data.description: Monitors delivery time for escalation if delayed

data.label: Deliver Order
data.instructions: Deliver order to customer and confirm delivery in app

data.label: Send Validation Error
data.description: Notifies customer of validation errors in their order

data.label: Send Payment Failed Alert
data.description: Notifies customer of payment failure with retry instructions

data.label: Refund Payment
data.description: Refunds customer payment when restaurant rejects order

data.label: Send Delay Alert
data.description: Alerts customer if delivery is taking longer than expected

routing.reasoning: This food ordering system requires complex workflow management with multiple user roles (customers, restaurant staff, drivers, admin), parallel processes (order preparation + driver assignment), state transitions, and real-time tracking. The system needs relational data modeling for orders, users, restaurants, and menu items with referential integrity. Advanced forms are needed for complex validation (checkout, payment processing) and mobile optimization is essential for customer and driver apps. Cross-platform approach ensures broad compatibility across devices.
